title: Mysterious Signal Around Earth Could Be Dark Matter
seoTitle: Mysterious Signal Could Be Dark Matter
subtitle: Research Uses Earth's Magnetic Field and Atmosphere as Planetary Detector
excerpt: A study leverages Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere to search for light forms of dark matter, improving axion limits and detecting intriguing dark photon signals.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Researchers have leveraged Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a planetary-scale detector, aiming to investigate some of the lightest proposed forms of dark matter.

This strategy significantly improved experimental limits on ultralight axions, hypothetical particles that could constitute part of the universe's dark matter.

Furthermore, the analysis revealed several intriguing signals of dark photons – another class of candidate dark matter particles – which still require further explanation from scientists.

With information from ScienceDaily.
